name: Iron Thunder
look: a robot Raikou with yellow armour over a grey frame, glowing cyan leg chevrons, a black gem-browed helmet with a red visor and yellow fangs, and five purple missile pods spitting cyan lightning
entry: A Pokémon resembling Raikou, recorded in a report about a storm that marched across the plains on four legs. The pods on its back fire bolts of lightning that it steers with a twitch of its shoulders.
how: Wild: very rare on plains and savannas during thunderstorms.
